lines.t: I'm good at walking when the road runs smooth,
But one wrong turn and I'm forgetting You.
I want the mountain, but I fear the climb,
I want Your heart, but I keep reaching for mine.
So when the sky goes grey and I lose my view,
When the hard things pull me away from You,
Don't let me love You only when it's easy—
Teach my wandering heart to follow You completely.
When it's hard to see You, teach me to trust You.
If I can't hear You, teach me to stay.
Oh, make me one with You,
In the things I say and the things I do.
Make Your hand the one I hold.
Oh, make Your heart my home,
Till I don't try to love on my own.
Till Your the breath in my lungs, the song I sing
Oh, make me one with You.
You in me, and I in You,
Every day, make the old heart new.
You in me, and I in You—
Let my life say what my lips say, too.
I know the things You've told me,
But forget them when I'm scared.
I want to stay when life gets heavy,
Not just find You when I fall.
I don't want a faith that comes and goes
I want to follow with my all.
When doubt comes knocking, don't let me run.
When I grow cold, be my rising sun.
When I forget that we're not apart,
Come make a home in this wandering heart.
Oh, make me one with You,
In the things I say and the things I do.
Make Your hand the one I hold.
Oh, make Your heart my home,
Till I don't try to love on my own.
Till Your the breath in my lungs, the song I sing
Oh, make me one with You.
Help me break the walls I built inside.
Take my fear of being wrong.
Let You be my only song.
Help me love You like You love me,
Help open my eyes so I can see.
Oh, make me one with You,
In the things I say and the things I do.
Make Your hand the one I hold.
Oh, make Your heart my home,
Till I don't try to love on my own.
Till Your the breath in my lungs, the song I sing
Oh, make me one with You.
